<!-- The fix and a regression test. -->

## Out of scope

<!-- Related improvements. Link the issue that owns each item, e.g. "Booking modes (#89)". -->

# Acceptance Criteria

<!-- The expected behaviour in the reported case, plus neighbouring cases that must keep working. No file names or code. -->

# Technical Details

<!-- Steps to reproduce, environment and version, logs or error messages, the suspected cause, and the issue or PR that introduced it. -->
